acceptance: After factory formatting and identity setup, record actual FAT32 type, sector size, cluster size, data-cluster count, free-cluster count and all existing file sizes. Do not infer usable capacity from 1GB marketing size.
Total data clusters must be at least the budget; unbudgeted files must be charged separately. No imported host metadata may be silently ignored.
After exactly 30h across three normal sessions, verify complete decryption/sample totals and at least 70 free clusters before separate recovery test.
More sessions or retained incomplete files require recalculation; no automatic deletion of user recordings to pass.
limits: Factory formatter and physical readback still unexecuted
